The '''5th Critics' Choice Super Awards', presented by the Critics Choice Association, will honor the best in genre fiction film and television, including Superhero, Science Fiction/Fantasy, Horror and Action, released between January 2024 and May 2025. The nominations were announced on June 11, 2025. The winners will be announced on August 7, 2025.
In the film categories, Deadpool & Wolverine and Thunderbolts* both led the nominations with six each, while in the television categories, HBO series The Last of Us led, also with six nominations.
